title.narrative: Safe4Whistleblowers 2: ​​Supporting an enabling environment for the protection of whistleblowers​ II

description.narrative: 'Transparency International (TI) and its partners in Germany (TI), Hungary (TI), Italy (TI), and Poland (AAF) aim to foster an enabling environment for the protection of whistleblowers in the EU. This project expansion to these four countries will seek to a) support the EU’s commitment to fundamental rights, particularly Article 11 on the right to freedom of expression, b) increase transparency and accountability across the EU by strengthening mechanisms for reporting corruption and other misconduct, and c) help create a more cohesive and unified approach to whistleblower protection across the EU, ultimately strengthening the protection of EU values and respect for the rule of law.To achieve these goals, we will:1. Increase knowledge of the general public, (potential) whistleblowers, CSOs, and journalists about whistleblowing and protection frameworks 2. Improve implementation of whistleblowing laws at the workplace3. Improve implementation and enforcement of whistleblowing laws by national authorities4. Improve the availability of gender-disaggregated data to assess the effectiveness of national whistleblowing laws5. Improve the effectiveness and coherence of the Directive’s implementation
